title: Chapter 7018: Want To Kill Me?

Chapter 7018: Want To Kill Me?

Chapter 7018: Want To Kill Me?

Immortal Bronze’s deal was truly tempting; everyone stared at Xiaolou Tingxue enviously.

“Very well, I’m not an unreasonable person. I will give face in return for such generosity.” He responded to Immortal Bronze before turning to Snowdragon: “Miss, come out, this is the end of this matter.”

Snowdragon hesitated for a second before sighing, unable to oppose a primordial immortal.

“Senior, come with me?” She asked Till Ancestor, still remembering his kindness in the past.

The opponents didn’t care at all because Till Ancestor’s presence did not influence the outcome either way.

“Senior, please leave.” Ye Fantian bowed. She herself didn’t leave because this was her lineage, not because of the celestial source.

Moreover, an outsider such as Heaven’s Equal was willing to stand up for her. If she were to leave, she would become unworthy.

“My old bones don’t have that much time left, I have made a promise and will guard this place.” Till Ancestor smoked his pipe.

“Then I suppose I’ll die here with you too.” Mo Xiangsheng joked.

Snowdragon bowed deeply before leaving the withering domain and standing behind Xiaolou Tingxue.

“Monarch, the situation looks unfavorable for you.” Immortal Bronze was certain of victory: “It is not too late to leave, that will be the end of this.”

The situation changed without Xiaolou Tingxue’s involvement. They didn’t mind killing Heaven’s Equal now.

“Unfortunately, I can’t leave before you all do.” Heaven’s Equal shook his head.

“Is upholding justice worth losing your life?” Ash-serpent sneered, believing he alone could take on the old monarch.

“Hahaha, it will take quite a lot of effort and time to kill me.” Heaven’s Equal laughed.

The opponents had a serious expression since he spoke the truth. Although the two had the advantage, killing a primordial immortal was not easy.

Destroying his physical body was one thing but grinding down the true fate would be an arduous task. Only a celestial immortal could expedite the process.

“Monarch, please reconsider.” Immortal Bronze uttered coldly.

“No need, I’ll be right here. Come, all of you.” The monarch smiled, displaying an invincible aura looming above his peers. Sure enough, he was living up to his title.

The duo exchanged glances, having no other choice but to get through him. As for Xiaolou Tingxue, he was content to do nothing.

“So be it, excuse us then.” Immortal Bronze said before ordering: “Begin the suppression.”

Autumn Wind and the two brothers were surprised. How could they suppress a primordial immortal?

“Do you think you can obtain the source while doing nothing?” Ash-serpent’s voice sent a chill down their spine.

“Everyone, suppress him and we will deliver the finishing move.” Immortal Bronze spoke, leaving no room for refusal.

The allies lamented their fate. This was no different than sending them in as cannon fodder to deplete Heaven’s Equal’s energy. The two would wait for an opening before attacking. It appeared this bowl of soup wouldn’t be so easy to get.

Xiaolou Tingxue smirked, seemingly amused at this development.

“Start.” Immortal Bronze ordered again.
